effective_date_basis: Section 3 says hereby revoked; complete two-page original derivative contains no delayed effectiveness. Date is the instrument's January 3 signed date; publication occurred January 13.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Express predecessor revocation is unqualified. The successor order preserves independent statutory authority, OMB functions, applicable law and appropriations; its succession exceptions do not qualify the separately enumerated predecessor revocation.
leads: Statutory eligibility and independent agency authority survive. Completed/accrued effects and any earlier target ending require per-target review.
Acting order itself was expressly revoked by EO14148 section2; this rule does not infer revival of predecessor or undoing of completed amendment.

legal_effect: Research lead only. Rule records an express revocation, not the first substantive cessation or an accepted target lifecycle.

Sec. 3. Revocation. Executive Order 13615 of May 21, 2012 (Providing an
